title: Urd plugin manifest (plugins/<id>/plugin.json)
description: Manifest for an Urd plugin. The plugin's entry is an ES module that exports register(Urd) and uses the same define APIs as the core - including the migration contract. See docs/SKJEMA.md.

allOf.$comment: entry and provides are required for anything but a pure language pack, which has no code to run (0.6.8.10).

requiresEngine.description: Semver range for compatible engine versions, e.g. ">=0.1.0 <1.0.0"

names.description: Optional (additive from 0.6.8): display name per admin language (ADR-0012). Key = language code (nb/nn/en-GB/se/tr), value = name; admin shows names[admin language] with name as fallback.

locales.description: Optional (additive from 0.6.8): true promises locales/{nb,nn,en-GB,se,tr}.js with the plugin's texts (ADR-0012). The loader puts them in the visitor registry (the site language) and in preview also in the admin registry; the parity test keeps the files in sync.

languages.description: Optional (additive from 0.6.8.10): languages the plugin delivers as a LANGUAGE PACK (ADR-0012). Each entry promises locales/site/<code>.js and/or locales/admin/<code>.js. A pack cannot override Urd's built-in languages (nb, nn, en-GB, se, tr), and a pure language pack needs neither entry nor provides.

code.description: The language code (BCP 47), e.g. "sv" or "pt-BR". Urd's built-in languages cannot be overridden by a plugin.

name.description: The language's OWN name (endonym), shown in the language pickers

site.description: The pack covers the visitor texts (locales/site/<code>.js)

admin.description: The pack covers the admin chrome (locales/admin/<code>.js)

csp.description: Optional (additive from v0.6): external origins the plugin needs CSP exceptions for. _headers is never changed automatically; admin shows the need to the owner (see ADR-0006).

maler.$comment: The legacy name for templates (ADR-0021); still read, not written in new manifests.
